rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by full name and zip code, identified the correct order, presented options, obtained explicit confirmation, and successfully modified the pending order item with the correct refund. However, the user also requested to correct the address across orders and their user address. The agent only executed a modify_user_address update and did not update the shipping address on the pending orders. Despite that, the agent stated that the shipping address had been updated, which is unsupported by any tool result (no modify_order_address call and no order re-check to confirm the new address). This constitutes providing unsupported information and failing to complete the address update as requested. Therefore, it does not meet the pass bar.
